title: 426. Reverse Vowels of a String

examples.explanation: The four vowels I,e,e,A are written back as A,e,e,I.
The vowels e,e,o,e are written back as e,o,e,e.

hints: Walk in from both ends, skipping non-vowels, and exchange vowels when both pointers land on one.
Test vowel membership case-insensitively against the set {a,e,i,o,u}.
